resources.string: A short note after a night asleep: how much the battery used, and anything unusual.
Notifications are blocked for BooxUltimatum, so the note can’t show.
No sleep of 4 hours in the log yet
Couldn’t read the log just now.
Switch off a display that stays on

If the display stays on while the tablet is asleep, which can drain a whole night, it starts after 2 minutes and keeps trying every few minutes until the display goes off. It tells the Boox sleep screen that the display is on, asks it to refresh, locks the screen, wakes the tablet and locks it again, and with Shizuku presses the wake and sleep keys. After each try the log says which step worked; none has been seen to work on this tablet yet, and Shizuku is only needed for the last.
Refresh the sleep screen while asleep

While the tablet sleeps, this asks the sleep screen to refresh every 30 minutes if nothing else has. On this tablet the display has stayed on overnight, draining the battery, each time 90 minutes passed without a refresh after Android had restarted by itself. A refresh costs well under 1 mAh a night. It is a precaution against that pattern, not a proven cure.
The display-off attempt (experimental): %1$s, and the display went to sleep.
The display-off attempt (experimental) failed: the display stayed on.

Android restarted by itself and the tablet hasn’t been restarted since. Until it is, the tablet can’t sleep deeply and may use several times as much asleep, and after the last two restarts like this the display stayed on all night and the battery emptied. Restart the tablet (hold the power button, then Restart) before you leave it asleep.
The processor stayed awake while the tablet slept

Its processor stayed awake through a sleep of %1$s. That uses several times as much battery and can leave the display on all night. A restart has cleared it each time it has been seen. Hold the power button, then Restart.
An app kept the tablet awake while it slept
The tablet’s processor stayed awake through a sleep of %1$s because an app held it awake. Battery › Causes shows which.
